added: Perform mode fills the whole screen on phones and tablets, hiding the status and navigation bars until you exit. On a computer, the Full screen button, or F11 (Ctrl-Cmd-F on macOS), takes Perform over the whole display, and Esc or exiting Perform puts the window back.
changed: In Perform mode, the down and Page Down keys scroll a card that is too long to fit before moving to the next slot, so a keyboard or page-turner pedal can read to the end of a long dance. Up and Page Up scroll back to the top before going back.
fixed: Closing the app while its window is full screen no longer makes it reopen at full-screen size.
